metadata.question: Is the size of ozone hole (<220 Dobson units) over Antarctica between September 26 and 30, 2024 larger than that between August 26 and 30, 2024?

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).

   - Compute valid pixel counts; if zero for a period: C2.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const antarctica = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, -90, 180, -60], geodesic: false});
    const scale = 25000; // meters
    const p1Start = '2024-08-26';
    const p1EndExcl = '2024-08-31'; // include Aug 30
    const p2Start = '2024-09-26';
    const p2EndExcl = '2024-10-01'; // include Sep 30

    // Helper: pick ozone band and DU factor based on band names
    function detectBandAndFactor(bandNames) {
      const names = bandNames.map(n => (n || '').toString());
      // Prefer names containing 'ozone'
      let chosen = names.find(n => n.toLowerCase().includes('ozone'));
      if (chosen) {
        // Heuristic: if name suggests number density/mol, convert to DU.
        const ln = chosen.toLowerCase();
        const needsConv = ln.includes('number_density') || ln.includes('density') || ln.includes('mol');
        return {band: chosen, duFactor: needsConv ? 2241.15 : 1.0};
      }
      // Next: any 'o3' band
      chosen = names.find(n => n.toLowerCase().includes('o3'));
      if (chosen) {
        const ln = chosen.toLowerCase();
        const needsConv = ln.includes('number_density') || ln.includes('density') || ln.includes('mol');
        return {band: chosen, duFactor: needsConv ? 2241.15 : 1.0};
      }
      return null;
    }

    // Try candidate datasets, select first with data in both periods
    const candidates = [
      {id: 'TOMS/MERGED', fixedBand: 'ozone', fixedFactor: 1.0},
      {id: 'NASA/OMI/Aura/OMTO3e'},
      {id: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3_TCL'}
    ];

    let chosen = null;

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      try {
        const icAll = ee.ImageCollection(cand.id);
        const ic1 = icAll.filterDate(p1Start, p1EndExcl).filterBounds(antarctica);
        const ic2 = icAll.filterDate(p2Start, p2EndExcl).filterBounds(antarctica);
        const [n1, n2] = await Promise.all([ic1.size().getInfo(), ic2.size().getInfo()]);
        if ((n1 || 0) > 0 && (n2 || 0) > 0) {
          let band = cand.fixedBand;
          let duFactor = cand.fixedFactor;
          if (!band) {
            const firstImg = ic1.first();
            const bands = await firstImg.bandNames().getInfo();
            const det = detectBandAndFactor(bands || []);
            if (!det) continue;
            band = det.band;
            duFactor = det.duFactor;
          }
          chosen = {id: cand.id, band, duFactor};
          break;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next candidate
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('No dataset with images in both periods (Aug/Sep 2024).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosen.id}, Band: ${chosen.band}, DU_factor: ${chosen.duFactor.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log('Region: S of 60°S; scale=25km');

    async function computeStats(start, endExcl) {
      const ic = ee.ImageCollection(chosen.id).filterDate(start, endExcl).filterBounds(antarctica);
      const n = await ic.size().getInfo();
      if ((n || 0) === 0) {
        return {images: 0, validCount: 0, coveragePct: 0, meanDU: null, holeAreaMkm2: 0};
      }
      const med = ic.median().select([chosen.band]).multiply(chosen.duFactor).rename(['DU']);
      // Mask invalid values
      const du = med.updateMask(med.gt(0)).updateMask(med.lt(1000));
      const regionArea = await antarctica.area({maxError: 1}).getInfo(); // m^2
      const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}).combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.sum(), sharedInputs: true});
      const hole = du.lt(220).selfMask().rename('hole');
      const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e12).rename('areaMkm2'); // million km^2 per pixel
      const areaImg = hole.multiply(pixelArea);

      const stats = await ee.Dictionary(
        ee.Image.cat([
          du.rename('DU'),
          ee.Image(1).rename('ones'),
          areaImg.rename('holeAreaMkm2')
        ]).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().forEachBand(ee.Image.cat([du])).combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}).combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.sum(), sharedInputs: true}),
          geometry: antarctica,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e13,
          tileScale: 2
        })
      ).getInfo();

      // Extract safely
      const meanDU = stats && (stats.DU_mean ?? stats.mean ?? stats.DU);
      const validCount = stats && (stats.DU_count ?? stats.count);
      const holeAreaMkm2 = stats && (stats.holeAreaMkm2_sum ?? stats.sum ?? 0);
      // Coverage percent by comparing area of valid DU pixels to region area using count*pixel area approx
      const validAreaM2 = (validCount || 0) * (scale * scale);
      const coveragePct = regionArea > 0 ? Math.min(100, (validAreaM2 / regionArea) * 100) : 0;

      return {
        images: n,
        validCount: validCount || 0,
        coveragePct: coveragePct,
        meanDU: meanDU,
        holeAreaMkm2: holeAreaMkm2 || 0
      };
    }

    const p1 = await computeStats(p1Start, p1EndExcl);
    console.log(`Aug26-30: Images=${p1.images}`);
    if ((p1.validCount || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('Aug: No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Aug ValidPx=${p1.validCount}, Cover=${p1.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}%, MeanDU=${(p1.meanDU !== null && p1.meanDU !== undefined) ? p1.meanDU.toFixed(1) : 'null'}, HoleArea=${p1.holeAreaMkm2.toFixed(2)} Mkm^2`);

    const p2 = await computeStats(p2Start, p2EndExcl);
    console.log(`Sep26-30: Images=${p2.images}`);
    if ((p2.validCount || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('Sep: No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Sep ValidPx=${p2.validCount}, Cover=${p2.coveragePct.toFixed(1)}%, MeanDU=${(p2.meanDU !== null && p2.meanDU !== undefined) ? p2.meanDU.toFixed(1) : 'null'}, HoleArea=${p2.holeAreaMkm2.toFixed(2)} Mkm^2`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (p1.meanDU === null || isNaN(p1.meanDU)) || (p2.meanDU === null || isNaN(p2.meanDU)) ||
                    (p1.holeAreaMkm2 === null || isNaN(p1.holeAreaMkm2)) || (p2.holeAreaMkm2 === null || isNaN(p2.holeAreaMkm2));
    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const isLarger = p2.holeAreaMkm2 > p1.holeAreaMkm2;
    console.log(isLarger ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected errors: method error, band mismatch, memory, etc.
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
